title: Your Teen’s First Part-Time Job: How to Help Them Start Without Hovering
summary: Use a short first-job routine to help your teen ask normal questions, check basic safety information, and own routine employer communication without taking over.
seo_title: Teen First Part-Time Job: Parent Guide
seo_description: Help your teen prepare for a first part-time job, check ordinary first-shift basics, and handle normal employer communication without taking over at home.
release_move: The parent helps the teen prepare questions and check ordinary safety basics, then lets the teen manage routine communication with the employer.

core_belief_shift.from: A teen needs a parent to manage every detail of a first job in order to be ready.
core_belief_shift.to: A teen can own routine employer communication when a parent provides bounded preparation and keeps appropriate safety safeguards.

book_relevance.reason: The War Playbook gives optional teen-owned practice in preparation, clear thinking under pressure, and asking before reacting; this guide remains complete without it.

next_step.reason: Optional teen-owned practice for preparation and clear thinking under pressure.
